phases.name: Start of Round
phases.summary: In Rounds 2-5, rotate the two leftmost Market and Imperial Orders; refill displays, ready Techniques, and reset once-per-round Kiln abilities.

phases.name: Work Phase
phases.summary: Players alternate placing one worker and resolving that location until all have passed or placed all workers.

phases.name: Firing Phase
phases.summary: If kiln is not empty, resolve pre-contribution abilities, secret Wood, Base Heat, Fire, zone heat, quality and firing abilities.

phases.name: Order Phase
phases.summary: In turn order, complete any number of Orders. Single-ceramic Imperial Orders advance Progress by 1 and multi-ceramic Imperial Orders by 2, up to space 5.

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.summary: Return workers, unlock Apprentices, pass First Player and advance Round.
